Christian charity · Montréal · since 2014

Kindling hope, one heart at a time.

Kimia na motema means “peace of the heart” in Lingala. We stand beside orphans, widows, families in need and people without a home — free of charge, for the glory of Elohim alone.

Four ways we help

Where the need is felt

Our four areas of aid meet everyday, practical needs — regardless of language, colour or origin.

  • Food

    Food baskets, supermarket drives and shared meals: no one should face the day on an empty stomach.

  • Clothing

    Clean, warm clothes chosen with respect, especially as the Québec winter sets in.

  • Education

    School supplies, homework help and access to books, so every child can build a future.

  • Material or financial

    Practical help when a family, a widow or a student is going through a hard time.

The Heart Circle

A monthly gift, a light that stays on

Circle members give the amount of their choice every month. That steady support lets us plan outreach rounds, food baskets and back-to-school help with confidence.

Transparency

Every dollar, in full light

  • Open books

    Our annual report is published online as a web page anyone can read.

  • Safe giving

    Online gifts go through Zeffy. We never publish our bank details.

  • Dignity first

    First names only, no exact locations, and consent before every photo.
